thread:
maya: Quick sync from the postmortem — we saw a delayed ingest window that undercounted token usage for 2026-03-21 22:00 -> 2026-03-23 05:00. Estimated ~120k tokens missed, spans ~480 accounts. Need owners for: backfill job, invoice adjustments, customer comms sample. Postmortem here: https://redwood.internal/pm/billing-ingest-delay-2026

sam: I can take the backfill job. Planning to run a dry-run on a small slice first. ETA for dry-run: EOD today. ETA for full backfill: tomorrow evening (03/24). :hammer:

jordan: I'll own invoice corrections and credits pipeline. Need a canonical list of affected invoices + amounts. Can you export ledger rows?

maya: Jordan — ledger export is here: `s3://billing-exports/delayed-ingest/3795004321/` (CSV + md5). Use column `reported_tokens` vs `actual_tokens` to compute delta.

sam: Dry-run SQL I ran on a sample (works):
```sql
SELECT account_id, sum(actual_tokens) - sum(reported_tokens) as token_delta
FROM metering.events
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-21' AND '2026-03-23'
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING token_delta <> 0
LIMIT 100;
```
I'll paste results after dry-run.

emily: FYI SRE observed the ingestion retry queue stalled due to a race with the dedupe worker (root cause in postmortem). We pushed the patch and increased retry concurrency. We should still scan for any recurring patterns in the last 90 days.

li: For customer comms, I'll draft a templated note and sample 20 accounts of varying sizes for review. Need the final credit amounts list from Jordan before send. :envelope_with_arrow:

jordan: Extracted invoice candidates (preview attached): 480 accounts, median token delta = 210, top 10 accounts account for ~60% of token delta. I'm going to run the invoice adjustment job with a dry-run flag `--no-commit` first.

maya: Action items (from thread):
- sam: dry-run of backfill on sample (EOD today) :hammer:
- sam: full backfill if dry-run OK (03/24 evening) :rocket: 
- jordan: generate credits/invoice adjustments list + run `--no-commit` (03/24 morning) :money_with_wings:
- li: draft customer comms and review 20 samples (03/24 afternoon) :memo:
- emily: scan last 90 days for recurrence & report anomalies (03/25) :mag:

sam: Dry-run results: sample 100 accounts -> 12 with deltas, token deltas small except 2 outliers. No schema issues. Will start full backfill at 18:00 UTC unless someone objects.

jordan: Ran `--no-commit` and compared expected credit vs invoice rows. Minor rounding differences on 7 invoices — flagging for accounting review. Will resolve rounding before commit.

emily: 90-day scan in progress. Quick note: saw 3 other small windows with similar failure mode but lower volume (~2-5 accounts each). I'll include a timeline in the report.

li: Draft comms ready — pinging for review: https://redwood.internal/comm-templates/billing-delay-draft. Please review before 15:00 UTC.

maya: Sounds good. Jordan, once rounding is fixed and sam confirms backfill completed, mark `invoice_status=ready_for_commit` and tell li so she can send comms.

jordan: Will do. Calendar check: propose a short postmortem follow-up on 03/26 11:00 UTC to confirm closure and learnings.

sam: +1 for 03/26 11:00. I'll add a quick runbook note for preventing regressions (`ingest.retry.window` tuning).

emily: I'll add a recurring monitor alert for ingest queue stall counts and a daily report for 2 weeks.

maya: Thanks all. I'll own the action tracker and update the postmortem with links and final statuses. Please drop quick ✅ in thread when your item is done so I can close the loop.
